analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: SPX is trading at the 7600/20 support zone. If it holds, the desk expects an extended phase of range-trading. A close below 7600/20 would trigger a downtrend with targets of 7580 and 7510.
DAX: while 25,170 holds as support, the desk targets 25,335 and then 25,445. A break below 25,170 targets 25,020 and the 200 DMA at 24,875.
EuroStoxx50: while 6060 holds as support, the desk targets a rebound to 6080 and the 200 DMA at 6105. A break below 6060 targets 6020 and 6000.
SMI: while 14,475 acts as resistance, the desk targets a down-move to 14,395 and 14,295. A break above 14,475 targets 14,605 and 14,655.
